sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा फलैः मूलैः पुष्पैः च अन्यैः च राघवम् ।पूजयित्वा यथा कामम् ततो अगस्त्यः तम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-१२-३१॥
transliteration: evam uktvā phalaiḥ mūlaiḥ puṣpaiḥ ca anyaiḥ ca rāghavam ।pūjayitvā yathā kāmam tato agastyaḥ tam abravīt ॥3-12-31॥

translations.english: Having said this to Rama, (the sage) honoured him by offering fruits, roots, flowers and other things as desired. He then said to Rama once again:
